newsitem.title: USA: COMSAT elects four new members to board.
newsitem.headline: COMSAT elects four new members to board.

text.p: COMSAT Corp said Friday its shareholders elected four new members to its board at the company's annual meeting.
In addition, the company said shareholders approved a proposal to authorize the granting of stock awards in lieu of the annual cash retainer for directors.
New directors are Marcus Bennett, Kathryn Turner and Larry Schafran and Guy Wyser-Pratte.

In addition, eight incumbent directors were re-elected to additional terms expiring at the next annual meeting. They are Betty Alewine, Lucy Wilson Benson, Edwin Colodny, Lawrence Eagleburger, Neal Freeman, Caleb Hurtt, Peter Likins and Robert Schwartz.
